description: The private-transport envelope: exact encoded bytes (Go json.Marshal escaping, padding), decode with per-item rejection, item cost (K-VB-1, K-VB-2), freshness against the horizon, response encode/decode (detail), coherence validation, and the serving classification (cash_order, cash_withdraw_quote, cash_withdraw and its cancel served as cash_lookup; cash-mode shapes; the I8 refusals).
source: nipcash/transport/{envelope,response,validate,identity,bearer}.go, nipcash/reuse.go; envelope_test.go, response_test.go, serve_test.go, nipcash/reuse_test.go, auditB_duplicate_item_test.go
